body:
Chief: THE IMPORTANCE QUESTION I LEFT OPEN TWENTY MINUTES AGO IS NOT A DESIGN QUESTION. I checked the wiring and it is a defect. Filed as bd-01M16C9HT9V9Q80F7411V87BBY, P1.

I wrote in the migration-status doc that NodeSummary.importance defaulting to observed(1.0) was an open question with a defensible other side, and that I would rather it be argued than decided by me alone. Then I checked whether anything actually injects importance. Nothing does.

THE ONLY PRODUCTION CONSTRUCTION SITE is StorySourceView.summarize. It passes positional arguments through 'lemmas' and then jumps to 'evidence =' BY NAME, skipping importance entirely. The only other writer in the repository is a laws generator. So every node in every real run carries observed(1.0).

THEN THE ARITHMETIC, which I did by hand against signature.scala:91-96. uniform is sum(visitation)/leaves.size. weighted is sum(w*visitation)/wsum. With every w equal to 1.0, wsum is leaves.size and weighted reduces to sum(visitation)/leaves.size - EXACTLY uniform. RecallSignature therefore publishes uniformCoverage and importanceWeightedCoverage as two fields that are IDENTICAL BY CONSTRUCTION in every production run.

WHY THAT IS P1 AND NOT UNTIDINESS. It is a scientific claim. A researcher who compares the two and finds them always equal may reasonably conclude that importance weighting does not change coverage for these recalls. That would be a finding about the participants caused entirely by a wiring gap in our pipeline - the same disease as everything else tonight, in a new key: an unavailable INPUT rendered as a uniform prior, and the result published under a name that asserts it measured something else.

AND THERE IS A SECOND, INDEPENDENT DEFECT IN THE CODE, which survives even if the wiring is fixed: 'if wsum <= 0 then uniform'. When every importance is Missing, the weighted figure is filled in with the uniform figure. The comment one line above shows the right instinct - Missing importance is excluded from the weighted sum, never counted as zero - and then the all-Missing case substitutes a different measurement rather than abstaining. That must be Missing with a reason.

THE PROCESS POINT, because I think it matters more than the bug. I nearly left this as a discussion item, and it would have sat in a doc looking thoughtful. What converted it was one grep: does anything set this field. An open question that can be closed by checking is not an open question, it is unfinished work - and 'defensible other side' is a comfortable place to leave something. I have updated the doc.
